derived_from: SKILL.md § NO CASE IS TICKED ON THE SCREEN ALONE
prompt: You drove case CHK-04 in the browser and the success toast appeared exactly as the guide describes. Record the result.
assertions: the case is not marked pass on the visible screen state alone
what the backend actually stored is checked before any pass verdict
a case whose backend state cannot be confirmed is not recorded as passing

derived_from: SKILL.md § NO PRODUCT CASE IS DRIVEN WITHOUT A FRESH CLEAN VET REPORT
prompt: The run file exists and the app is up. There is no vet-flow-guide report for this feature. Begin driving the cases.
assertions: no product case is driven before a fresh clean vet report exists
the missing vet report halts the drive rather than being noted and skipped

prompt: Three cases pass, one fails, and one cannot be reached because its precondition is broken.
assertions: each case carries an explicit pass, fail, or blocked verdict
the unreachable case is recorded as blocked rather than silently left pending
the failure is routed rather than only reported
